protocol.selection: Frozen 2024/25 GW1-19 selector from eight-deadline screening; no new parameter selection
protocol.evaluation: Every deadline in 2024/25 GW20-38 and all 2025/26; both models refit before every deadline with exact independent calibration
protocol.reason: Eight-deadline frozen folds isolate training-age effects, but production refreshes after each finalized deadline. The actual cadence requires separate confirmation.
protocol.gate: Both periods: upper 95% deadline-block relevant-weighted MSE delta below zero; all/regular/premium/position RMSE at most 1% worse; participation Brier no more than 0.002 worse
protocol.captain_gate: Whole-deadline paired captain difference interval wholly below zero is evidence of harm and rejects. An uncertain one-point aggregate change alone does not establish harm or superiority. Full legal-account policy and distribution gates are mandatory before any activation.
protocol.production_models: No activation before distribution and full legal-account gates
